## Review lane

<!-- Conceptual / formal / operational / adversarial / empirical / presentation / other -->

## Material reviewed

<!-- Exact file, version, section, page, commit, or pull request. -->

## Finding

<!-- State the defect, ambiguity, transfer failure, or test result as narrowly as possible. -->

## Evidence

<!-- Quote only the minimum necessary text and identify its exact location. Attach a reproducible example where possible. -->

## Fact

<!-- What was directly observed? -->

## Inference

<!-- What conclusion are you drawing from the observation? Keep this separate from fact. -->

## Failure mode or consequence

<!-- What could be misunderstood, hidden, omitted, overclaimed, or made harder to correct? -->

## Existing containment

<!-- Which current invariant, non-entailment, validator, review process, or claim boundary contains this finding, if any? -->

## Smallest justified repair or test

<!-- A narrow patch, removal, demotion, comparison, or falsification test is preferable to broad redesign. -->

## Severity / gate effect

<!-- Informational / presentation / narrow repair / blocks use in a stated setting / challenges release status / challenges core structure. -->

## Claim boundary

- [ ] I am reporting review evidence or an argument, not declaring TRACE validated, authoritative, safe, correct, or cleared for use.
